llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=repository
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@example.auth.session
role Own refresh-token rotation, replay detection, and family revocation for the example service.
owns refresh-token family, session revocation
excludes access-token signing, user profile storage
invariant One token family has at most one live refresh token.

@example.billing.credit
role Own credit reservation and capture boundaries for generation jobs.
owns credit reservation, reservation capture
excludes provider invoice settlement, subscription entitlement
invariant Captured credits never exceed the active reservation.

@example.privacy.export
role Own preparation and expiry of user data export jobs.
owns export manifest, temporary export object
excludes account deletion, long-term archive storage
invariant Every export object expires after the configured retention window.

@llmnav.agent.install
role Install one managed navigation protocol into instruction files used by major coding agents.
owns agent instruction adapters, managed instruction blocks
excludes postinstall mutation, agent execution
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query

@llmnav.cli.dispatch
role Expose initialization, validation, generation, search, evaluation, and diagnostics through one CLI.
owns command dispatch, terminal output, exit codes
excludes semantic rule definitions, index persistence format
rel workflow>llmnav.project.initialize, workflow>llmnav.rules.validate, workflow>llmnav.search.query, workflow>llmnav.eval.measure, workflow>llmnav.audit.coverage

@llmnav.eval.measure
role Measure whether repository task queries retrieve expected semantic IDs within configured rank gates.
owns search regression tests, recall metrics, evaluation gates
excludes benchmark task execution, model quality scoring
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query

@llmnav.index.generate
role Compile validated semantic cards into deterministic repository and module catalogs for coding agents.
owns stable card order, generated index, cache catalogs
excludes source semantics, agent search decisions
rel workflow>llmnav.rules.validate, workflow>llmnav.index.incremental, workflow>llmnav.index.inverted, workflow>llmnav.index.transaction

@llmnav.project.initialize
role Create a repository's LLMNav configuration, registry, schemas, agent instructions, and initial index.
owns project bootstrap, configuration templates, initial generation
excludes package installation, automatic annotation
invariant Bootstrap writes and index generation share one repository lock.
rel workflow>llmnav.agent.install, workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.rules.validate
role Reject unstable, ambiguous, oversized, or structurally invalid LLMNav metadata before indexing.
owns semantic lint rules, coverage rules, registry consistency
excludes source rewriting, search ranking
rel workflow>llmnav.syntax.parse

@llmnav.search.query
role Rank cards from task language and pack confidence-weighted repository graph context.
owns query ranking, graph ranking, multilingual aliases, context expansion
excludes embedding generation, source mutation
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate, workflow>llmnav.index.inverted, workflow>llmnav.graph.generate

@llmnav.syntax.parse
role Parse LLMNav source comments into deterministic semantic cards and rewrite them canonically.
owns comment grammar, card materialization, canonical serialization
excludes semantic validation, repository search

@llmnav.index.changes
role Describe changed cards, affected boundaries, and generated catalogs as stable machine-readable records.
owns card diff, boundary impact report, catalog impact report, change ordering
excludes source mutation, cache commit
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.index.incremental
role Reuse unchanged file parses and card records while rebuilding deterministic generated artifacts.
owns file fingerprints, parsed-file state, incremental scan metrics
excludes source comment mutation, cache directory commit
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.index.inverted
role Compile searchable card fields into a deterministic inverted index that can be updated one card at a time.
owns posting lists, card search documents, incremental token reuse
excludes semantic source syntax, query presentation
rel workflow>llmnav.search.tokenize, workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.index.transaction
role Commit a complete generated cache with rollback and crash recovery across POSIX and Windows rename behavior.
owns cache staging, directory swap, generation recovery
excludes artifact semantics, source indexing
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.search.tokenize
role Normalize task text and emit deterministic word and CJK n-gram tokens for semantic retrieval.
owns query normalization, CJK n-grams, tokenizer version
excludes card ranking, inverted-index persistence
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query

@llmnav.contract.fingerprint
role Fingerprint repository API and configuration contracts without coupling them to source locations.
owns contract fingerprint schema, export selection, contract drift comparison
excludes semantic version decisions, source mutation
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.structure.boundaries
role Detect durable artifact, route, event, schema, migration, runtime, and command boundaries from generated local evidence.
owns boundary kinds, confidence assignment, boundary evidence
excludes framework execution, source annotations
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.index.search-shards
role Split a compact search index into deterministic card-range artifacts without retokenizing documents.
owns search shard schema, card range partitioning, shard manifest
excludes query ranking, source parsing
rel workflow>llmnav.index.inverted, workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.graph.import
role Load and validate optional generated definition and reference indexes without executing repository code.
owns graph import schema, input normalization, graph input diagnostics, source snapshot consistency
excludes graph ranking, source mutation
invariant Compiler facts are combined with scanned source only when their validated contents agree.
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.graph.generate
role Build deterministic repository graphs with content-addressed partitions and resolve qualified IDs across workspace nodes.
owns graph schema, edge normalization, local import resolution, workspace ID resolution, graph partition invalidation
excludes query scoring, workspace file discovery
rel workflow>llmnav.graph.import, workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.agent.prompt-bundle
role Assemble deterministic prompt-prefix partitions with explicit cache scope and integrity hashes.
owns prompt bundle schema, partition ordering, cache boundaries, bundle integrity
excludes provider cache API calls, volatile task context, source discovery
rel workflow>llmnav.agent.tool-schema, workflow>llmnav.agent.install, workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.declaration.extract
role Attach symbol cards to language declarations and derive structural metadata without executing source.
owns declaration attachment, signature extraction, import extraction, source declaration candidates
excludes semantic card parsing, type-system resolution
invariant String literals and comments do not create false declarations or imports.
rel workflow>llmnav.project.scan

@llmnav.project.scan
role Scan project sources into semantic card and file records with declarations, imports, and content hashes.
owns project scan, card record assembly, source metrics
excludes semantic validation, cache generation
invariant Generated paths and structural metadata remain derived data and are never written into source cards.
rel workflow>llmnav.declaration.extract, workflow>llmnav.syntax.parse

@llmnav.eval.conformance
role Measure repository-specific navigation evidence and preserve unmeasured language gaps before stability claims.
owns conformance matrix validation, repository verdicts, language evidence coverage
excludes source mutation, cross-repository score averaging
invariant A passing repository cannot hide a failing repository through aggregate metrics. Missing adoption or insufficient reviewed cases remains held rather than passing or failing.
rel workflow>llmnav.eval.measure

@llmnav.structure.modules
role Resolve repository-contained language modules without executing project toolchains or following metadata symlinks.
owns language module identity, Go module discovery, Go package import resolution
excludes dependency installation, external module lookup, semantic card generation
invariant Module resolution reads only regular repository-contained metadata files and never executes a language toolchain.
rel workflow>llmnav.project.scan, workflow>llmnav.graph.generate

@llmnav.support.runtime
role Supply injectable clock, process identity, randomness, sleep, environment, and liveness probes for deterministic tests.
owns runtime injection, deterministic identity, process liveness, deadline scheduling
excludes filesystem access, generation policy

@llmnav.support.abort
role Expose cooperative cancellation checks so long scans, queries, and generations can stop at bounded checkpoints.
owns abort checks, abort error normalization
excludes cancellation sources, retry policy

@llmnav.support.policy
role Keep named policies for search ranking, audit prioritization, source limits, declaration scanning, and context sizing.
owns search ranking weights, search input limits, audit scoring, source byte limits, declaration scan limits, token estimates
excludes query execution, configuration loading, agent transport
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query, workflow>llmnav.agent.tool-schema, workflow>llmnav.audit.coverage

@llmnav.support.concurrency
role Run independent filesystem work with a bounded number of in-flight tasks while keeping results ordered.
owns bounded asynchronous map, deterministic failure selection, concurrency limit validation
excludes retry policy, thread pools, request scheduling
invariant Results keep input order and the lowest failing index is reported regardless of completion order.

@llmnav.support.read-operation
role Bound idempotent reads with cooperative cancellation and opt-in transient retries.
owns read deadlines, read retry scheduling, retry jitter
excludes write retries, transaction recovery, shared cache ownership
invariant Cancellation and deadline failures never start another attempt.

@llmnav.agent.freshness
role Prepare current source-derived indexes before opt-in MCP navigation requests.
owns source change stamps, on-request incremental generation, refresh failure reporting
excludes filesystem watchers, source annotation, request cancellation ownership
invariant Only a successful uncancelled generation advances the prepared source stamp.
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.search.discover
role Find source files and heuristic declarations before a repository has semantic cards or generated indexes.
owns unannotated source navigation, file and declaration ranking, candidate provenance
excludes business rule inference, source mutation, semantic ID assignment
invariant Automatic candidates carry source provenance and never claim reviewed semantic contracts.
rel workflow>llmnav.declaration.extract, workflow>llmnav.audit.coverage

@llmnav.structure.analyze
role Connect opt-in compiler or syntax declarations to semantic cards with explicit analysis precision.
owns compiler adapter orchestration, generated structural IDs, source freshness proofs, analysis publication
excludes dependency installation, project execution, runtime dispatch inference
invariant Analysis output is validated, precision is explicit and source changes invalidate it before publication or graph-input loading.
rel workflow>llmnav.graph.import, workflow>llmnav.search.discover

@llmnav.structure.compiler-process
role Bound opt-in compiler subprocesses and retain cancellation, failure, and exit ownership.
owns compiler process deadlines, bounded output, process cancellation, exit cleanup
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.go
role Prepare offline Go dependency exports and invoke the standard-library type analysis producer.
owns offline Go metadata, Go analyzer build, temporary executable lifetime
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.typescript
role Resolve an installed TypeScript Compiler API and run source analysis in an isolated process.
owns compiler resolution, TypeScript worker invocation
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.typescript-worker
role Resolve TypeScript declarations and symbol uses through the compiler type checker without emitting code.
owns compiler symbol identity, alias resolution, lexical owners, TypeScript diagnostics, selected source consumption hashes
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.go-worker
role Resolve Go object identity and lexical references from standard-library type information.
owns Go declaration identity, cross-package reference resolution, receiver identity, physical source positions, Go UTF16 offsets, Go source consumption hashes
excludes project execution, module installation, runtime dispatch inference
invariant Compiler-selected production sources determine references and line directives never replace physical locations.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.eval.real-navigation
role Measure repeatable source navigation tasks on copied real TypeScript and Go code without altering original repositories.
owns real-source corpus provenance, retrieval condition comparison, index maintenance measurements, held model evidence
excludes model coding success claims, human authoring time estimates, original source mutation
invariant Candidate retrieval measurements never stand in for model task completion or unmeasured human maintenance.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.eval.model-coding
role Grade actual model edits on isolated mutated real source with acceptance tests unavailable in the model workspace.
owns coding outcome oracles, condition rotation, sanitized tool traces, model usage accounting
excludes production source modification, sealed holdout claims, self-reported success grading
invariant Every scored mutation first passes a pristine-positive and mutant-negative oracle control.

@llmnav.eval.serena-navigation
role Compare semantic lookup on copied real source using Serena and the frozen declaration oracles.
owns Serena retrieval measurements, symbol input mapping, external tool provenance
excludes model coding outcomes, timing superiority claims
invariant Tool failures remain failed observations and never become substitute text searches.

@llmnav.structure.typescript-metadata
role Project compiler types and callable signatures into generated declaration metadata.
owns TypeScript type origins, callable parameters, metadata categories
excludes compiler installation, source mutation, business meaning inference, semantic card validation
invariant Only compiler-resolved types and declarations supply metadata and type origins.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.typescript-worker

@llmnav.eval.metadata
role Measure opt-in compiler metadata costs and bounded retrieval against explicit source facts.
owns metadata comparison fixtures, real declaration probes, synthetic member lookup measurements
excludes model token accounting, project execution, dependency installation, semantic card validation
invariant Script observations distinguish output bytes and synthetic lookup costs from real agent token use.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze, workflow>llmnav.structure.metadata

@llmnav.evidence.files
role Hash explicitly selected repository files for local provenance without retaining their contents.
owns evidence path containment, bounded byte fingerprints, file handle lifetime
excludes semantic card validation, secret content storage
invariant Evidence paths remain inside the repository and open handles close after errors or cancellation.

@llmnav.eval.local-analysis
role Measure additional language metadata and on-demand provenance costs in disposable repositories.
owns additional language fixtures, history lookup observations, verification receipt costs
excludes model token accounting, application execution, dependency installation
invariant Measurements use disposable inputs and never equate output bytes with actual model tokens.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze, workflow>llmnav.evidence.history, workflow>llmnav.evidence.verification

@llmnav.structure.python
role Extract Python declaration metadata with an isolated standard AST parser without importing application code.
owns Python syntax metadata, annotation origins, lexical ownership, syntax diagnostics, Python source coordinates
excludes type checking, import resolution, call inference, application execution
invariant Only explicit annotations provide types and parsing never imports target modules.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.rust
role Extract conservative Rust declaration syntax with explicit limits instead of claiming compiler type resolution.
owns Rust lexical metadata, declared parameter types, local impl ownership, syntax precision
excludes macro expansion, crate resolution, type checking, conditional compilation
invariant Comments, literals and macro token trees never create declarations and unresolved impl ownership remains unknown.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.rust-process

@llmnav.structure.rust-process
role Isolate Rust syntax analysis so deadlines, cancellation and heap failures cannot block the calling event loop.
owns Rust worker invocation, Rust analysis failure isolation
excludes type checking, macro expansion, application execution
invariant CPU-intensive Rust parsing runs only in a bounded child process and cancellation waits for its exit.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze, workflow>llmnav.structure.compiler-process

@llmnav.structure.rust-worker
role Run conservative Rust syntax extraction inside the owned analysis subprocess.
owns Rust worker input decoding, analysis result transport, analysis error transport
excludes type checking, application execution, process lifecycle ownership
invariant The worker parses source as data and its parent owns deadlines, cancellation and process exit.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.rust, workflow>llmnav.structure.rust-process
